title: fighters in depth: the core's numbers (Simulation, sim/core/depth.gd)
description: data/combat/depth.json: the switch and the numbers of a fighter's depth outside a flight (docs/architecture/depth-core.md): `enabled` (false until the director's depth window; with it off nothing here is read by a match), `maxBhPerSec` (the cap on a drift in depth, in body heights a second), `faceMarginBh` (how far a fighter keeps from a standing building's face) and `capExempt` (the causes of depth the cap does not hold: push, carry, home, magnet, shove, sidestep, giveGround). An optional `schema` string, "combat.depth/1", is accepted (the file carries none today, so the version-field rule is waived for this schema in tools/lib/selftest.js). Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore.

enabled.description: The one switch: fighters in depth on or off (a setup may set its own "depth").

maxBhPerSec.description: The cap: the most a drift in depth moves a fighter, in body heights a second, outside a flight or a rush.

faceMarginBh.description: A fighter outside a flight keeps his centre this far from a standing building's face, in body heights.

lineSinMin.description: The sine of the least angle a brawl line makes with the street.

lineSinMax.description: The sine of the most angle (at least lineSinMin: depth-line-order).

arriveSin.description: An approach ends this share of its street offset to one side in depth, as a sine.

homeAfterTicks.description: Ticks a fighter waits before easing back to his home depth.

homeBhPerSec.description: How fast he eases back, in body heights a second.

director.description: Optional. The directors own depth numbers (sim/director/brawl.gd; docs/director/depth-d1.md).

capExempt.description: The causes of depth the cap does not hold (distinct): push, carry, home, magnet, shove, sidestep, giveGround.
